Subject: Lost Pixel Gems — Public Documentation & Audit Intake (Call for Auditors)

Hi,

The Lost Pixel Gems project has published its final documentation and an audit intake system for public review. Repo: https://github.com/ARTBYDCOT/LOST-PIXEL-GEMS

What to review:
- Full docs and guides in /docs and /documentation
- Machine registry: documentation/lost-pixel-gems-docs/contracts.json
- ABI folder (for auditors): /contracts (will contain verified ABI files)

How to submit an audit:
- Public: open a new issue using the "Audit request" template
- Private/sensitive: submit a Security Advisory per SECURITY.md

Thank you for your time and expertise.
